stories.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that disrupted thousands of flights

stories.description: The Trump administration is asking the justices to overturn lower court decisions that found it was illegal to block asylum applications following an executive order that called the situation at the southern border an “invasion.”

stories.title: Chinese scientists fired after child dies in world’s first brain gene-editing attempt
stories.description: The world’s first attempt to edit genes inside a child’s brain, which killed a six-year-old girl in Shanghai last year, has led to the firing of scientists following an official investigation that found they had broken research rules and taken money from her family. The investigation, ordered by the Communist Party’s Shanghai municipal committee and the local government, concluded on Friday that the researchers had not shared worrying results from monkey tests with the girl’s doctors beforehand.

stories.title: Alaskans opt to stick with ranked choice voting
stories.description: For the second time in as many election cycles, Alaska voters rejected a ballot measure that sought to undo the unusual system, which faced scrutiny in the state’s Senate race.

stories.description: More than twice as many U.S. measles cases were counted this year as there were in all of 2025. This week, experts for the Pan American Health Organization will rule on the country's elimination status. CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder has more.

stories.title: Nvidia's board preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, sources say

stories.title: Congo Ebola outbreak still out of control after six months, MSF says
stories.description: The group says that many cases are likely being missed and that transmission in hospitals in some areas is rife.

stories.title: Bernie Sanders says he won’t support Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
stories.description: Sens. Sanders and Elissa Slotkin called for new leadership, but neither proposed an alternative. Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is considering challenging Schumer.

stories.title: India news: Delhi air quality level 'severe' after Diwali

Why it matters : The visit by Roman Gofman, one of Benjamin Netanyahu's closest confidants, comes as the Israeli prime minister is pressing President Trump to resume the war against Iran. stories.title: Mississippi elects first Black Senator since 1874

stories.title: U.S. inflation report highlights strain of rising food, energy and housing costs
stories.description: High inflation persisted last month, providing little relief for Americans struggling with affordability. It is driven largely by food and energy price increases, but housing costs also rose. The country appears to be headed for an annual inflation rate of about 4% this year. To discuss what it means for the economy, Geoff Bennett spoke with Austan Goolsbee of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago.

stories.description: Sales of existing homes in the U.S. fell last month to their lowest level in more than 16 years. That's according to a new report by the National Association of Realtors. In October alone, sales dropped to 3.75 million homes, an 8.8% drop compared with the same time last year. Stephanie Sy reports on what's driving the decline.
